name: Connectivity I.T.
summary: Warragul IT firm, renamed ANYCAST HOLDINGS PTY LTD (ACN 128 650 635); wholesale telco (AS58511) with DCSI; acquired by Swoop May 2020, entity still active.

events.details: Connectivity I.T. Pty Ltd (trading name from Nov 2007).

Acquired by Swoop (as Anycast Networks). Operating entity ANYCAST HOLDINGS PTY LTD (ABN 41 128 650 635, ACN 128 650 635, Warragul VIC 3820) remains registered/active on ABR, trading as Anycast Networks Australia.
